conservative.requirements: Engaged with the target, target must be able to understand you. Effect: You flood your target with an endless stream of random chit-chat. While his card is recharging and the target is engaged with you, he adds {Dc} to all Social checks as he tries to get a word in edgeways. It costs one extra manoeuvre to disengage from you while this card is recharging.
conservative.name: Blather

bane.description: While this card is recharging, add {Dm} to all checks targeting you.

reckless.requirements: Special: perform another Social action while this card is recharging. Blather immediately recharges. Effect: You flood your target with an endless stream of random chit-chat. While this card is recharging and the target is engaged with you, he adds {Dc} to all Social checks as he tries to get a word in edgeways. It costs one extra manoeuvre for the target to disengage from you while this card is recharging.
reckless.name: Blather
